_comment: Codex catalog pins for generated .codex/agents/*.toml. This is the only place in the harness that holds GPT catalog IDs (ADR-0022, ADR-0025). WHICH tier an agent belongs to is NOT here — it is that agent's own frontmatter model: (opus = top / sonnet = mid / haiku = light; anything else, including inherit, falls to default_tier). This file only maps a tier to a catalog id and a reasoning effort. When OpenAI retires a slug, edit this file and run ./init.sh codex. Do not copy these values into .claude/agents/*.md or into a skill body.
